maya: Heads-up — proposing onboarding for "mellon-7b-q" (new 7B family, quantized). Posting intake + suggested eval/regression gates. Target: basic bring-up + quant experiments by EOD Fri.

ash: Thanks. What's priority vs other 7B/13B candidates?

maya: Priority = P1 for midterm customers (chat + code completion). Reason: big latency/cost wins on Dedicated. If regression-free, plan hosted alpha rollout.

jonathan: Proposed minimal checklist:
- Sanity: model loads, KV cache stable, no tensor shape issues
- Eval harness: IF-1000 (instr-follow), MultiTurn-100 (chat coherence), TruthBench (hallucination), Safety quick checks
- Quant matrix: q8_0, q4_0, q4_1 runs on same seed
- Perf: p50/p95 latency, token cost profile, memory usage
- Regression gates: thresholds below

oliver: Infra note: need a job slot on dev-gpu-2 (A100-80GB). Request queued, will reserve for the run.

maya: Regression gate (proposal):
- Instruction F1 drop <= 2% vs baseline (rw-vicuna-7b-v1)
- IF-1000 mean >= 87 (absolute) or within -1.5 of baseline
- Avg token cost improvement >= 18% for q4_0 variant
- p95 latency <= baseline * 1.15
- Hallucination increase <= 1.5% absolute on TruthBench
- Safety: toxicity rate delta <= +0.3% absolute

jonathan: Add quick pass criteria for harness outputs so CI can gate automatically:
- IF-1000 coverage >= 90%
- MultiTurn coherence >= baseline - 1.5
- Win/loss regression check: no category > 3% worse than baseline
- Human spot-check (n=10): acceptability >= 90% (manual)

maya: Quick run command to start the harness:
```
python eval/run_harness.py --model mellon-7b-q \n  --prompts data/if1000.json \n  --quant q4_0 \n  --seed 42 \n  --out results/mellon_q4_if1000.json \n  --workers 8
```

eval-bot: Triggered run: mellon-7b-q on dev-gpu-2. Job id: run_4829. Artifacts will appear in CI.

ci-bot: run_4829 completed. Summary: IF-1000 mean=88.1, F1 drop vs baseline=1.2%, p95 latency=180ms (baseline 160ms), token_cost delta = -21%.

maya: Quick safety sniff: toxicity delta +0.1%, hallucination +0.9% — within proposed gate.

oliver: Can we get detailed logs + example failure slices? Please upload examples.csv and raw logs.

eval-bot: Artifacts uploaded: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/run_4829/ (eval.json, examples.csv, logs.txt)

ash: Suggest adding a canary rollout plan: 5% hosted traffic for 48h, monitor p95 latency, token cost, instruction F1. Auto-rollback triggers: instruction F1 drop > 1.5 OR p95 > baseline*1.2 OR safety delta > +0.5%.

maya: Updated model intake card on the onboarding board with checklist, thresholds, and run links. Will attach human-eval ticket.

jonathan: I'll schedule a human eval batch (n=50) next Tue to validate edge-case instructions. If pass, promote to Dedicated stress tests.

maya: Follow-ups (owners):
- oliver: ensure reproducible job specs + hardware labels in the job metadata
- jonathan: finalize prompts & human eval plan
- ash: confirm rollout + SLA notes for hosted canary

oliver: On it. Will add job template and tag with run_4829 for repro.

maya: Thanks everyone. Leaving this thread pinned to the intake card for visibility.
